screenshots.name: desktop-time-prediction.png
screenshots.findings: The complete selector and 5 s to 10 s change are readable. The selected half prediction, 50 W to 25 W equation and half-length striped comparison are clear; keyboard focus is visible and the cards align cleanly.

screenshots.name: desktop-efficiency-prediction.png
screenshots.findings: The 100% to 50% efficiency change visibly doubles input power from 40 W to 80 W. The full selector, selected double prediction, reciprocal relationship and solid/striped shared-scale bars fit.

screenshots.name: dark-phone-work-prediction.png
screenshots.findings: At 320 pixels in dark mode, the full Time to input energy selection now fits. The normalized 30 s to 60 s inputs, same-energy prediction, 250 J readings and equal solid/striped bars stack cleanly; equations and buttons wrap without clipping.

screenshots.name: forced-colors-phone-load-prediction.png
screenshots.findings: At 320 pixels with forced colors, the full Load to input power selector fits. The 50 N to 100 N change doubles power from 6.25 W to 12.5 W; system-colored radios, borders, focus outline and solid/striped bars remain clear without horizontal overflow.

limitations: Native React/THREE with local Chromium software WebGL; no deployed host build exercised.
Forced colors is browser emulation; no physical assistive technology session.
